operations.title: The prime cross trace requires an indefinite double
operations.statement: A scalar Hilbert Schur complement has a fixed-sign quadratic resolvent measure, whereas each nonzero logarithmic prime propagator has oscillating cut density. Polarization realizes the cross term exactly as the difference of two positive quadratic resolvents, hence in a signature (+,-) double. The coefficient-Betti pairing supplies the slots but a source-derived positive quotient is still required.
operations.scope: Exact no-go for a single positive Hilbert Schur complement and exact finite-cutoff Krein polarization; full completed positive quotient remains open.
